title: Jonah Hex Lot of 12 DC 2006 Series 9 11 12 14 16 24 31-33 36 38 40 Darwyn Cooke
condition_description: Most covers clean and bright; #9 and #16 show more wear (spine and edge wear, back-cover scuffing on #16). Every front pictured, plus the backs. See photos.
description:
Jonah Hex (DC Comics, 2006 series) by Justin Gray and Jimmy Palmiotti - 12 issues, mostly done-in-one stories. $2.99 cover price each.

You get:
- #9 (Sep 2006) - Tony DeZuniga cover
- #11 (Nov 2006) - "The Hanging Tree", guest-starring El Diablo
- #12 (Dec 2006) - Paul Gulacy cover
- #14 (Feb 2007) - "The Horrifying Origin of Jonah Hex Continues Here!" - Jordi Bernet
- #16 (Apr 2007) - Phil Noto cover
- #24 (Dec 2007) - Special Halloween issue
- #31 (Jul 2008) - Richard Corben cover
- #32 (Aug 2008) - Jordi Bernet
- #33 (Sep 2008) - Darwyn Cooke art and cover
- #36 (Dec 2008) - "Seven Graves Six Feet Deep"
- #38 (Feb 2009) - Jordi Bernet
- #40 (Apr 2009) - "Sawbones" wanted-poster cover

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a box.
